info.title: Kokoro Agent internal HTTP API
info.description: Agent-owned execution admission, control, evidence and identity-scoped chat query boundary. The BFF consumes this contract; the Agent does not expose browser SSE or AG-UI.

tags.name: runs
tags.description: Run admission, control and execution evidence.

AgentServiceBearer.description: BFF or another trusted service credential. The credential is supplied by deployment, never by a browser.

BillingModelCallReaderBearer.description: Dedicated kokoro-billing credential for exact model-call evidence reads.

RequestId.name: X-Request-Id
RequestId.description: Caller correlation identifier. The Agent creates one when absent.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable command identity. Reusing it with a different request body is rejected.

selected_skill_source_refs.description: Exact Platform SkillSourceRef values for this Run, in caller-selected order; explicit [] means no external Skill. The JSON array must encode to at most 4096 bytes.

selected_mcp_connection_ids.description: Exact Platform MCP Connection IDs selected for this Run, in caller order. Omission or [] selects no additional connections; selection is intent, not authorization. JSON ASCII encoding is limited to 4096 bytes.

ResumeControl.description: Full pending collection submission for one exact pause. The owner rejects duplicate, missing, extra or stale item identities as a whole; HTTP admission is not native consumption.

timestamp.description: Internal Agent event time in UTC epoch milliseconds; public BFF projections translate it to RFC 3339.

ChatInteractionState.description: Complete replacement of the pending collection, never a delta. Runtime additionally enforces globally unique group/item IDs, pause_revision <= interaction_revision, action_result.pause_revision <= pause_revision, exact current revision for resuming, and an earlier action revision for validation_failed waiting. Locator, arguments and submitted values are private and absent.

source_refs.description: Exact Platform SkillSourceRef values for this Run, in caller-selected order; explicit [] means no external Skill. The JSON array must encode to at most 4096 bytes.

attempt_binding_bytes_base64url.description: Original canonical RFC8785 UTF-8 JSON bytes, 1..65536, unpadded canonical base64url. Decoded shape is usage/v2 EvidenceIdentity with event_id removed; no other fields added. Its digest is ordinary SHA256 of these exact bytes.

planned_bytes_base64url.description: Original canonical usage/v2 PlannedBinding bytes; binding_version must be 2.0.0. Ordinary SHA256, not the final evidence digest domain. Never actual commercial attribution.

authorization_bytes_base64url.description: Current canonical usage/v2 AuthorizationObservation bytes: prepared/not_requested, authorization_pending/requested_unknown with original request_ref, or authorized/granted with original request_ref and admission_ref. This observation changes with state; it is not the creation receipt.

observed_at.description: Database time for the single joined read; lease expiry is observation, never a renewable dispatch permit.

Unauthorized.description: Service credential or trusted identity is missing or invalid.

NotFound.description: The identity-scoped resource does not exist.

Conflict.description: The idempotency identity was reused with a different request.

Unavailable.description: A required Agent dependency is unavailable.

202.description: Admission persisted and notification published or replayable.

post.summary: Admit an idempotent run control command

get.summary: Read one exact final model-call usage evidence artifact

403.description: Tenant assertion or identity context is forbidden.

404.description: Evidence is absent or not visible.

503.description: Reader authentication or dependency is unavailable.

get.description: Read the exact immutable sealed event, including historical revisions, for the authenticated Billing reader tenant and attempt. Independently validate the current head and requested event against frozen attempt facts; a corrupt or missing head fails closed. Return original artifact bytes, revision, digest and observation time. This read does not grant execution permission or modify authorization, evidence or funds.

get.summary: Read current frozen model-call preparation for Billing admission

200.description: Current read-only preparation observation, not an immutable historical receipt.

403.description: Tenant assertion or identity context is forbidden.

404.description: Preparation is absent or not visible.

503.description: Reader authentication or dependency is unavailable.

409.description: Current state or lease is unsuitable for admission; this is not proof of non-dispatch.

get.description: Dedicated Billing observation, not a dispatch permit or supplier cost bound. No query or request body. Only current usage2 prepared/pending/authorized attempts with live matching Run fence are visible as successful snapshots. Existing Billing receipt recovery does not require this read to remain available.
